mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty * avg_purchase_price), 0) FROM domestic_stock_balance WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND qty > 0 AND status IN ('HOLDING', 'PARTIALLY_SOLD', 'TRADE_RESTRICTED', 'TRADE_SUSPENDED')

SELECT dp.ticker, dsb.qty FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id WHERE dsb.account_id = #{accountId} AND dsb.qty > 0 AND dsb.status IN ('HOLDING', 'PARTIALLY_SOLD', 'TRADE_RESTRICTED', 'TRADE_SUSPENDED') ORDER BY dsb.domestic_stock_balance_id

SELECT YEAR(processed_at) AS purchaseYear, MONTH(processed_at) AS purchaseMonth, SUM(ABS(amount)) AS buyAmount FROM domestic_order WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND side = 'BUY' AND status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at <= #{asOf} GROUP BY YEAR(processed_at), MONTH(processed_at) ORDER BY YEAR(processed_at), MONTH(processed_at)
